item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We know what is at stake: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must act before that point—not pretend we can regain control afterward.

2. We reject the promise of an off switch. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. Prevention is our responsibility. Shutdown is not a fallback.

3. We cannot build superintelligent AI first and solve control later. If it is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We demand action before we cross that irreversible threshold.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We reject the comforting idea that we can press ahead now and reach for an off switch later. That is not a safety plan. It is a surrender of control over our future. We must act while the decisions are still ours to make, before an irreversible threshold becomes a reality. We are calling for prevention, accountability, and firm limits on development—not promises of rescue after deployment. We refuse to treat an irreversible loss of control as an acceptable price of progress.
